question:
Choose the word that means the same as the given word.

Nacreous
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 4' **i.e. **'Iridescent'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word** 'Nacreous' **pertains to nacre, also known as mother-of-pearl, which is a substance with an iridescent surface, usually lining the inner surface of some mollusk shells.(मोती के समान)
 
• **It means **something having the quality or luster of pearl.
 
• **'Iridescent'** is the correct answer as it also means showing luminous colors that seem to change when seen from different angles, similar to mother-of-pearl.(विचित्र रंगयुक्त)

Therefore, the **correct answer **is: **'Iridescent'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Now let's look at the other words:
 
 
• **'Monochromatic'** means having one color. It refers to a color scheme that is composed of different tones of the same color.(एकरंगी)
 
• **'Pale'** refers to a color that is closer to white than is usual or desirable; somewhat whitish.(फीका)
 
• **'Gloom' **does not have a connection with color. It means partial or total darkness, or a state of depression or despondency.(अंधकार)
 
 

3a:T60f,

The correct answer is 'Option 2'
